note: A judge is a model, so this does not reproduce to the decimal even at temperature 0. Agreement alone is the WRONG metric for choosing a judge: v2 agreed more often than v1 (76.7% against 66.7%) and was the worse judge, because it waved through 11 wrong answers against v1's 1. A generous judge passes bad output; a harsh one only annoys you. Read falseAccept and falseReject, not agreement.
